scope: Native application with public TIE/ln and Venator designs, actual Worker fleet geometry, and actual RTS wing launch/recall orders. Flight and hatch fractions are never assigned by this harness.

conditions.cache: Task-specific persistent Chromium profile preserves the normal IndexedDB asset cache across runs; fixture worlds and actual operation state are recreated each run. No cold-start/performance claim.
conditions.hatchWorld: An explicit isolated test world with one real public Venator, six B-wings and one real CR90 opposing contact at 30km. Arrival warp is cleared and both sides are ordered to hold fire before the world is run; the real detection/combat path activates flight operations. This is not a saved campaign or endurance benchmark.
conditions.renderObservation: Test-only wrappers retain the original draw/drawMesh calls and observe the actual runtime hatch map and door offsets.

stages.name: Actual public TIE/ln trial begins at the existing altitude on the evening/night side with the sun below the orbital horizon
Actual loaded Core and unmodified trial unit use the shared 70 percent hyperspace speed threshold
Native throttle input produces paid motion while the real sun direction and night-side location remain coherent
Real Venator geometry is rendered with closed roof metal above its six embarked aircraft; open-door and stationary-body rays independently clear the original aperture
An actual launch order opens its selected physical hatch; unused hatches remain closed in the live renderer
After the last aircraft clears the hatch, doors close while the squadron remains airborne
A production recall order reopens the selected hatch for actual landing traffic
All six aircraft finish landing and their physical doors close again
Actual Abregado trial uses its red stellar color for renderer illumination; the white-light control keeps white illumination

hyperspaceThreshold.scope: The actual current trial unit at its real velocity, without assigning speed or changing entry flags. Exact boundary cases are covered by Node regressions.

carrier.name: ヴェネター級｜双塔キャリア

roofGeometry.scope: Read-only numerical rays through actual Worker geometry. Reference heights come independently from the original owned hull loft via originalSurface and hullWorldPoint. The operational unit and its hatch state are not assigned. Door skin may lie above the raw roof; 0.05m permits float packing without accepting the much lower hangar floor.

stellarLighting.scope: Same unchanged public TIE/ln launched normally in each actual star system; these are independent visual scenes, not a controlled identical-sun pixel comparison.
